description: Ruby gemspec with a constant version, singular license/email, and interpolated metadata URIs. Covers metadata.component derivation from the root gemspec, version resolution from lib/**/version.rb, and lockfile reconciliation (discussions 4388/4389/4390). The registry-enrichment scenario replays real RubyGems API responses for four gems (rake, opentelemetry-api, opentelemetry-sdk, logger), locking in the API-driven authors, the library type of gems whose description mentions a framework (discussion 4405), the distribution references (discussion 4406), and the single Ruby platform component whose vers range intersects every required_ruby_version (discussion 4409).
